Mod.Name: 【便利】掌柜帮手·归类入箱 | [QoL] Shopkeeper's Kit: Sort To Boxes
Mod.Author: ChaosN
Mod.Description:
【便利型：不改任何数值，只帮你省操作】 归箱（G）：仓库里散放的货按大类（13 类：食物、饮料与水、日用品、医疗、化学、武器与弹药、材料、工具与设备、模组、种子与农业、养殖、文件证件、奢侈品与收藏，每件货只属于一个类）归进对应的箱子。勾选过分类的箱子按勾选收货（点箱子窗口标题栏 × 左边的“分类”按钮，或 Ctrl+G 指着箱子）：勾整类 = 下面全勾，取消整类 = 下面全取消，也可以单独勾某件；面板里只列出你在这个存档里见过的货，见过的越多越全。没勾选的箱子看里面现有的东西，有同款的优先。升级过的储藏区（扩容套件，多栏）每栏单独设置、单独归箱，一栏放满了接着放同箱的空栏。箱子（或某一栏）可设“不参与归箱”：自用的药品区、装备区不会再被塞进新货。箱子右下角显示里面物品的角标（约占箱子的一半）。指着柜台按 G：把柜台上你的货放回箱子或仓库。Shift+G：开关“买下时自动归箱”（默认关）。 上柜台（C）：把当前买家会买的货全部摆上柜台；指着仓库/箱子里的货按 C：把它的同款全部摆上柜台，指着柜台上的货按 C：把同款收回；可选：从仓库/箱子放一件上柜台时自动带上同款（默认关，Shift+C 打开）。同款按看得到的标签区分（水质、药品纯度、瓶子里装的液体）；箱子可设“不参与上柜台”，放你不想卖的东西。 钉住的物品、机器、箱子本身不会动；鉴定指南、扫描仪这类装备不会被摆上柜台。界面中英双语，跟随游戏语言。 掌柜帮手系列 · 作者 ChaosN · 由 Claude Code（Anthropic 的 AI 编程助手）协助开发。
[QoL - no balance changes] Sort (G): loose items in your storage go into the box for their category (13 categories, each item in exactly one: food, drinks & water, household, medical, chemistry, weapons & ammo, materials, tools & equipment, modules, seeds & farming, husbandry, documents & cards, luxury & collectibles). Boxes you tag via the "分类" button left of the close (×) button of an open box (or Ctrl+G while pointing at it) take only what you ticked: a whole category (ticks every item under it) or single items, listed only once you've seen them in this save; untagged boxes take what they already hold, identical items first. Upgraded storage bays (expansion kit, several tabs) are set up and sorted per tab; when a tab is full, items continue into an empty tab of the same box. A box or tab can be kept out of sorting, so your own medicine or gear stash never gets new goods. A badge in each box's bottom-right corner (about half the box) shows what it holds. G while pointing at the counter puts your items there back into boxes or storage. Shift+G toggles auto-sorting of purchased goods (off by default). Sell (C): put everything the current buyer wants onto the counter; C while pointing at an item in stock puts all identical items on the counter, and on an item on the counter takes them back; optionally, placing one item on the counter brings its identical copies (off by default; Shift+C turns it on). Identical means matching visible labels (water quality, drug purity, liquids in a bottle); boxes can be kept out of the counter for things you won't sell. Pinned items, machines and containers are never moved; guides, scanners and similar equipment are never put up for sale. UI in Chinese and English, following the game language. Part of Shopkeeper's Kit by ChaosN. Developed with assistance from Claude Code (Anthropic's AI coding assistant).
